description: This file defines a utility object and classes for a fate-sharing cache wrapper in Spark, utilizing Guava cache. It manages cache behavior, thread safety, and provides controlled cache operations.

classes.name: NonFateSharingCache
classes.description: A wrapper around Guava Cache providing thread-safe get, invalidate, and size operations with fate-sharing behavior.

classes.name: NonFateSharingLoadingCache
classes.description: A subclass of NonFateSharingCache that works with LoadingCache, providing a thread-safe get method.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Factory methods to create cache instances with various configurations, including from existing caches, loading functions, or size and expiration parameters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the cache, loading it if necessary, with thread safety.

methods.name: getIfPresent
methods.description: Returns the value if present in the cache, otherwise null.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Removes a specific key from the cache.

methods.name: invalidateAll
methods.description: Clears all entries from the cache.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the cache.
